qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum tightening torque for an M14 8.8 thread?
What is the tightening torque for an M14 12.9 thread?
What torque should I apply to an M14x1.5 8.8 thread bolt?
What torque specification applies to an M14x1.5 12.9 thread bolt?
What BMW standard should I refer to for the applicable range of tightening torques?
How much higher is the torque for M14x1.5 8.8 compared to standard M14 8.8 threads?
What section of the manual covers these M14 and M14x1.5 maximum tightening torques?
